component.name: Comical
component.summary: A graphical, lightweight and fast, e-mail client for Notmuch

description.p: Astroid is a lightweight and fast Mail User Agent that provides a graphical interface to searching, displaying and composing email, organized in threads and tags. Astroid uses the notmuch backend for blazingly fast searches through tons of email. Astroid searches, displays and composes emails - and rely on other programs for fetching, syncing and sending email.Comical is an easy to use and cross-platform CBR and CBZ reader which prefetches and caches pages for speed.
